scope: Real pellet events attributed by feeding batch; consistent most-recent-round and cumulative counters in canvas-adjacent feedback, tour and principle panel. Pause/continue, early hand withdrawal and repeat-feeding actions. No new rendering assets or photorealism claim.

automated.method: Node tests run actual production logic. Integration constructs production KoiSchool and HandInteraction, including actual rig/bones; texture canvas and image loading use lightweight stubs. No native browser, GPU or audio playback verification.

pelletLifecycle.landEvent: Actual freefall first contact with shared water height
pelletLifecycle.consumeEvent: Actual completion of 0.16s mouth swallow animation
pelletLifecycle.expireEvent: 14 simulated seconds after landing; separate from consumed
pelletLifecycle.handEnd: Natural hand withdrawal around 4s or explicit early stop; does not imply all pellets swallowed

nativeBrowser.reason: CUA process failed to start in current managed environment; reset and existing-tab reconnect did not recover. Normal shell startup also failed; automatically reviewed workspace-local shell execution succeeded.
nativeBrowser.finalPageOpen: Codex open_in_codex returned queued for final preview URL. This does not confirm native rendering.

limitations: Native desktop/mobile layout, focus and new WebGL render were not revalidated in this version because browser automation was unavailable.
